An '''arbiter-general''' was a position in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that involved arbitrating disputes between different [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], [[Species/Legends|species]], persons and [[City/Legends|cities]]. [[Mon Mothma's father/Legends|Mon Mothma's father]] held such a position, and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] learned [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] from him which served [[Gender/Legends|her]] well in her position as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="SWS" />
